overview_description: List and read scheduled events, run one now, or remove one before it runs.
intro: Events are actions scheduled to run later, such as an order cancellation with a future date. You can list and read them, run one straight away, or remove one so it never runs. This area has 4 endpoints, and all seven Exsited SDKs call every one.
warning: **Executing an event runs its scheduled action straight away.** Use remove instead if the action should not happen.
notes: **A scheduled change creates an event.** Cancelling an order with a future `effective_date` adds an `Order Cancel` event whose `executed_on` is null until it runs.
**Execute and remove take an empty body.** Send `{}`; the event is named in the path.
**A removed event cannot be removed again.** A second remove returns `404`.
**One event comes back under `event`.** A listing puts its records under `data`.
**Listings page by cursor.** Records sit under `data`; pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` to read the next page, and stop when `pagination.has_more` is `false`.

endpoints.title: List events
endpoints.summary: Lists scheduled and executed events, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns a page of events under `data`, with cursor `pagination`. Sort with `sort`, such as `-created_on` for the newest first. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, such as `filter_created_on_gte`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an event
endpoints.summary: Retrieves one event by its id.
endpoints.description: Returns the event under `event`. `executed_on` is null until the event runs.

parameters.name: event_uuid
parameters.description: The event's `id`, as the listing shows it.

endpoints.title: Execute an event
endpoints.summary: Runs a scheduled event now instead of at its scheduled time.
endpoints.description: Send an empty object as the body. Once the call succeeds, a read of the event shows `executed_on` set.

parameters.name: event_uuid
parameters.description: The event's `id`, as the listing shows it.

endpoints.title: Remove an event
endpoints.summary: Removes a scheduled event so it does not run, and returns it.
endpoints.description: Send an empty object as the body. The event comes back under `event`. Removing the same event again returns `404`.

parameters.name: event_uuid
parameters.description: The event's `id`, as the listing shows it.

event_name.description: What the event does, such as `Order Cancel`.

resource_type.description: The kind of record the event acts on.

resource_uuid.description: The uuid of the record the event acts on.

scheduled_to_execute_on.description: When the event is due to run.

executed_on.description: When the event ran. Null until it runs.

url.description: The path this page was read from.

limit.description: The page size applied to this page.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust this over `next_cursor`, which can still be set on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to read the next page.
